method: Calibrate a deterministic feature table using 540 known-truth synthetic training streams. For each prefix checkpoint, observable key checkpoint:directional_label:|slope/se| band. Score empirical commit-now mean cost against final240 wait cost; require group count>=20 and smoothed error rate*90 below waiting mean cost; ties go to observe. Only authorized feature 220:negative:hi. At end classify with SG052 original z4.327111573414373. No online truth, noise-regime label, programmed onset or future values in policy.

pilot.disclosure: Pilot negative against waiting and inspected before freeze; no further tuning after freeze.

prefix_replay.scope: Identical prefix replay, not independent mutation adversary

interpretation: The single empirical best-action group did not generalize to lower overall heldout cost; waiting until 240 dominates both SG054 and SG055 for modeled loss. This tests a deterministic total action ordering but not global optimality.
limitations: Calibration and holdout use same synthetic generator family, fresh seeds only.
Training risk estimates not calibrated upper confidence bounds and group count only 92.
Training authorized only one group; by construction all other early candidates observe.
Cost weights arbitrary synthetic research values, no measured real-world stake.
Prefix replay proves deterministic result on tested inputs but not robust noninterference against arbitrary suffix edits.
GitHub source published; no separate clean-checkout execution.
